semiconductor_relevance: High — Amazing Cool Technology produces advanced materials that enhance conductivity and reliability, crucial for semiconductor applications in high-demand sectors.
summary: Amazing Cool Technology specializes in the mass production of ACOOL Copper, a graphene-modified copper material that significantly enhances electrical, mechanical, and thermal performance. This innovative material is ideal for applications in electric vehicles, aerospace, drones, and high-voltage cabling, providing superior characteristics compared to conventional copper.
capabilities: Production of ACOOL Copper in flat wires, foils, and plates
Enhanced electrical and thermal conductivity materials
